### Zentalis Pharmaceuticals to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


September 2, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/575358700/files/doc_news/Zentalis-Pharmaceuticals-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-0ff14290c-2026.pdf)


SAN DIEGO, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zentalis® Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZNTL), a clinical oncology innovator advancing late-stage development of investigational first-in-class WEE1 inhibitor azenosertib as a biomarker-driven treatment approach for ovarian cancer, today announced that members of the management team will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


- Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference, Boston, MA. Fireside discussion, September 8, 2026, 4:30p.m. ET.


- Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference, New York, NY. Company presentation, September 14, 2026, 2:35p.m. ET.


Access to a live webcast of the Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley events, as well as an archived recording, will be available under the “Events & Presentations” tab on the Investors & Media section of the Company’s[website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8LCMP5LA82mpdg-3P5ETQbnQbSw9UwCrri36clLDWCaWhMB6ATsQ_yIrIvQTCUm4bAHKdxHbQPtaITCskwwnBuQ6x30P4dDeSkA4AtwQ0W8=) .


**About** **Zentalis** **Pharmaceuticals**
Zentalis is a clinical oncology innovator developing a treatment approach for ovarian cancer and multiple tumor types. Leveraging therapeutics development and biomarker expertise, Zentalis is advancing monotherapy and combination studies of its first-in-class WEE1 inhibitor, azenosertib. Focused on translating WEE1 science into clinical practice, we aim to equip physicians with a targeted, non-chemo, orally available medicine that enhances treatment experience, choice, and outcomes. Our mission: to unburden cancer patients with more convenience and care.​


For more information, please visit[www.zentalis.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ggG2HpIblx__RzBNCctn8Q7M9Ruo8w9frpAo7SPCiNjdQeH_piVDZjhTWdGbHTdFvSRjbyhMjsqfTHAEIotYEsExEAJ6fxewuslLiZ61Uug=) . Follow Zentalis on LinkedIn at[https://www.linkedin.com/company/zentalis-pharmaceuticals](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=94NlkOQfMSyzcnCLEbK9L_M6Xjzkp12HH6UcQZI1P_RzWnHyk4Z7bLTXHI2g3VvxLOUBD6dvgowhFezaQzp43KvpuZzM_1c_Xlq9yoLxufGWmmOwNTuODS-8TEBR1CURpCoXc_5zvCKd4O1M4soHyEsHP3ieOc83A5bqDVPLPQagKMikTeG7rhKMaNVzdzfe) .
